GainsBlock.rationale: `public override bool GainsBlock => true` (DefendIronclad.cs:13) == the class attribute.

ctor.rationale: `base(1, CardType.Skill, CardRarity.Basic, TargetType.Self)` (DefendIronclad.cs:19-22) == cost 1 / SKILL / BASIC / SELF. Note the C# class is DefendIronclad but the sim registers it as id `defend`; the roster resolves it through audit/tools/name_overrides.json, correctly.

CanonicalTags.rationale: `new HashSet<CardTag> { CardTag.Defend }` (DefendIronclad.cs:15) == the tag set. Load-bearing: the Fortified enchantment gates on `"defend" in card.tags` (enchantments.py:286-287).

CanonicalVars.rationale: `new BlockVar(5m, ValueProp.Move)` (DefendIronclad.cs:17) == `_block = 5`. Move WITHOUT Unpowered -> POWERED block on both sides, so Vambrace and Pael's Legion double it identically and this card is NOT in gap G1's blast radius (`py audit/tools/card_probes.py unpowered-block` lists only Entrench).

OnPlay.rationale: `CreatureCmd.GainBlock(Owner.Creature, DynamicVars.Block, cardPlay)` (DefendIronclad.cs:26) == `BlockCmd.apply(ctx.hooks, ctx.player, self._block, card=self)`. Single effect, no guards, no animation.
